user.title: Leapmotor (China) login
user.description: Use a SECONDARY account — Leapmotor allows only one active session per account, so using your main account will sign out the official app on your phone.

code.title: Enter SMS code
code.description:
A code was sent to {phone} and is **valid for 5 minutes**.

Expired or never arrived? Tick “Resend code” below and submit again.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong or expired code (valid 5 minutes). Tick “Resend code” and submit again.
error.risk_cooldown: Account flagged by risk control (1023). Wait 30+ minutes silently; retrying extends the cooldown
error.sms_too_often: SMS requested too often (36), retry in a few minutes
error.sms_failed: Failed to request SMS code, see logs
error.car_login_failed: Vehicle token exchange failed, see logs
error.no_vehicle: No vehicle on this account — make sure the car is shared with the secondary account

init.title: Leapmotor (China) options

data.operate_pwd: Vehicle operation PIN (4 digits, needed by sensitive commands)

init.description: Poll interval: 5 min while parked, 60 s while driving (position/speed only matter when moving). Slow-changing data (mileage/energy) is skipped while driving to keep request volume low.
